acceptanceCriteria: The MCP conformance suite runs the compiled binary with --tool-profile flows and checks tools/list and one call per flows tool against the official schema, and the AFU-V1-034 matrix row drops 'partial'.
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from PR #205 (V1-0254). AFU-V1-034 stays partial because the MCP conformance suite has no compiled-process vectors for `corvint-mcp --tool-profile flows`, and the official-schema run with the selector was not run.
title: mcp: no compiled-process MCP conformance vectors for the flows tool profile (AFU-V1-034 partial)
